notes: MLA/MP information is informational and location-based only. Representatives listed here are NOT the resolving authorities for civic issues unless explicitly stated elsewhere.

Assembly segment numbering follows the current post-delimitation (2023) Assam electoral roll. Mangaldai is AC-50 (SC) in Darrang district; Darrang-Udalguri is the post-delimitation successor to Mangaldoi Lok Sabha.
Sipajhar AC numbers vary by delimitation (pre-2023 No.66 vs post-2023 No.49); stored here as AS-049 per current Lok Sabha segment list. Dalgaon is AS-051.
No personal contact details are stored by design.
Guwahati data retained for demo diversity; Mangaldai/Darrang-Udalguri added for the August 2026 Mangaldai presentation. All verified 2026-08-22.
